name: Logflare Logging
description: Structured log ingestion and search with Logflare — real-time tailing, alerting, and BigQuery export.

requiredSecrets.name: LOGFLARE_API_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Logflare API key from your account settings

requiredSecrets.name: LOGFLARE_SOURCE_ID
requiredSecrets.reason: Logflare source UUID to route logs to

postInstallNotes:
1. Create a source in your Logflare dashboard and copy the UUID into `LOGFLARE_SOURCE_ID`.
2. Log calls are fire-and-forget — they never block your request path.
3. For pino integration, use `pino-logflare` transport to pipe all logs to Logflare automatically.
